div.span:
8 curves × 240 points × 2 bytes = 3840 B
Frequencies are not stored per point: point k sits at f0 + (f1 − f0)·k / 239
Values are int16 in 0.01 dB → ±327 dB range, 0.01 dB resolution
Total used: 4084 of 4096 bytes
